description:
Give every PDF a clear identity.

PDF Librarian helps you organize book and research PDFs on your Mac. Import files, find bibliographic records, review metadata, and save with a consistent name in one three-column workspace.

IMPORT PDFs
Select multiple PDFs or folders. Keep track of each file and resume its workflow from the sidebar.

FIND METADATA
Search public catalogs using clues from filenames and selectable PDF text, including titles, ISBNs, and DOIs. Compare candidate records before choosing one.

EDIT & WRITE
Edit 12 Dublin Core fields. Compare the metadata currently stored in your PDF against the proposed values before writing. Changes and cleared fields are highlighted for review.

SAVE & RENAME
Preview and edit a filename built from title, author, publisher, year, and language. Matching field colors make the parts easy to follow. Confirm the destination in the macOS save dialog.

MADE FOR YOUR MAC
• Adjustable content and detail columns with a fixed workflow sidebar
• Three appearance choices: blue, warm sage, and dark
• Simplified Chinese and English interfaces
• Built-in metadata tools; no separate ExifTool installation needed
• Native macOS file access and App Sandbox

Your PDFs stay on your Mac. An online search sends bibliographic clues to the selected public sources, not the complete PDF. No account is required. Public catalog coverage and availability may vary.

Requires macOS 13 or later. Supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
promotionalText: A clearer PDF library: import, find metadata, compare changes, and save with a consistent name. Three themes. English and Simplified Chinese.
whatsNew:
A redesigned workspace for your PDF library.
• Follow four steps in a three-column layout, with a fixed sidebar and adjustable detail panes.
• Import multiple PDFs and jump back to each file’s progress.
• Compare the current PDF metadata with proposed changes before writing, including fields that will be cleared.
• Follow five matching colors from bibliographic fields to the filename preview.
• Choose blue, warm sage, or dark appearance, in Simplified Chinese or English.
• Includes ExifTool for reliable metadata writing without an extra installation.
